summary.headline: Jupiter’s Temperament Challenged
summary.text: Astrological argument against Jupiter’s traditional classification as well-tempered: because it lies between hot Mars and cold Saturn, and shares their dryness, it should not be called temperate. Ptolemy’s claim that Jupiter is hot and wet is challenged through Galen’s theory of equal qualities, seasonal and southerly conditions, preserved meats, and Hippocrates’ second and third Epidemics, which associate hot-wet conditions with putrefaction and bodily disease.
